Consistency check done and fixes applied. **Tasks are back for approval — still the tasks gate, no code yet.**

## What the analyze pass found and what I did

- **C1 (HIGH — your flagged gap): fixed.** The save flow now delivers *all* FR-001 fields, not just URL + title:
  - **T028** (save form) now includes **tags with existing-tag suggestions**, description, a markdown note, and a **read-later toggle** — on the save flow itself.
  - **T025** (POST route) explicitly accepts and persists `{url, title, description, note, tags[], unread}`.
  - **T022** (bookmark model) links tags on create; **T021** (test) asserts all provided fields — including tags and unread — persist at creation.
- **I1 (MEDIUM): fixed.** Tag infrastructure (model, `/api/tags`, `TagInput`) moved into **Foundational (T014–T016)** because it's cross-cutting — used by save, edit, filter, bulk, saved views, and import. This is what makes suggestions available *at save time* rather than only when editing. **US7** is now correctly scoped to the tag-**filter** UI (T051–T052).
- **U1 (LOW): fixed** — POST body made explicit (T025).
- **L1 (LOW): fixed** — corrected a stale FR reference in data-model.md.
- **O1 (LOW):** SC-007 (≥90% metadata capture) left as an observational metric; no artificial task invented for it.

## Net effect on the breakdown

- **77 tasks** (was 76), renumbered cleanly for the new ordering.
- **Zero critical issues**, 100% requirement coverage, no unmapped tasks.
- The MVP is unchanged in spirit but now correct: **US1 delivers the complete save experience** (URL + tags/suggestions + description + note + read-later + auto-metadata), then list + edit.

If this looks right, **approve the tasks** and I'll proceed to **speckit-implement**, building in priority order and validating each story at its checkpoint. If you'd like to defer any P3 stories from v1, tell me now and I'll adjust before implementation.
